description: Land Title Settlement Department - Udabokalawela, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320328 (23/0638)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances) in various villages in the Kandy District. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
